_note: Teach2D matching 2D scenes (docs/VIDEO-TEACH2D.md): flat Lexkite-Kit vector rooms, 0 credits, no text, no people, nothing moving. Depth layers: far wall band (window light, wall-to-floor shading), mid furniture, near props on the counter. Items in canvas px per format (short 1080x1920 for the v2 corner/side layouts: card region y < 1150 stays empty, wall 1150-1660, floor 1660-1830, counter top 1830; wide 1920x1080: x >= 1072, counter top 900). k r=rect o=ellipse ring=ellipse outline p=polygon g=soft radial light pool lg=linear gradient (a -> a2, dir h = left to right); c = theme.json token ('tint' = series tint), a = alpha; l 'front' = drawn above the teacher (on the counter), g = prop group (scene.py slides / shrinks / steps it behind so it never covers the teacher), default behind. build.py adds floor, contact shadow and the counter; qc.py scene_clear checks them.
